Sync protocol for bead-forge.\n//!\n//! Implements flush (SQLite → JSONL) and import (JSONL → SQLite) operations\n//! for git-backed bead synchronization.\n\nuse crate::config::{find_beads_dir, load_metadata};\nuse crate::jsonl::{export_jsonl, export_jsonl_dirty, import_jsonl, UpsertResult};\nuse crate::model::Issue;\nuse crate::storage::Storage;\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse chrono::Utc;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\n\n/// Sync operation results.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]\npub struct SyncResult {\n    pub imported: usize,\n    pub exported: usize,\n    pub updated: usize,\n    pub skipped: usize,\n}\n\n/// Flush all beads from SQLite to JSONL.\n///\n/// This is the primary export operation for git commit. Exports all beads\n/// sorted by ID for stable diffs.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `workspace_dir` - Path to the workspace root (contains .beads/)\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(usize)` - Number of beads exported\npub fn flush(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<usize> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir).ok_or_else(|| {\n        anyhow::anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display())\n    })?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let jsonl_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.jsonl_export);\n\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    // Get all issues for export\n    let issues = storage.list_all_issues()?;\n\n    // Export to JSONL with atomic temp+rename\n    let result = export_jsonl(&jsonl_path, || Ok(issues.clone()))?;\n\n    // Update export_hashes for all exported issues\n    update_export_hashes_for_issues(&storage, &issues)?;\n\n    // Clear dirty marks - all beads have been flushed to JSONL\n    storage.clear_dirty()?;\n\n    Ok(result.count)\n}\n\n/// Flush only dirty beads from SQLite to JSONL.\n///\n/// Incremental export for faster sync on large workspaces. Only exports\n/// beads that have been modified since the last flush.\n///\n/// NOTE: This function exports ONLY dirty beads to the JSONL file, replacing\n/// its contents. For a full export of all beads, use `flush()` instead.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `workspace_dir` - Path to the workspace root (contains .beads/)\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(usize)` - Number of beads exported\npub fn flush_dirty(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<usize> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir).ok_or_else(|| {\n        anyhow::anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display())\n    })?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let jsonl_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.jsonl_export);\n\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    // Get dirty issues for export\n    let dirty_issues = storage.list_dirty_issues()?;\n    if dirty_issues.is_empty() {\n        return Ok(0);\n    }\n\n    // Export to JSONL with atomic temp+rename (only dirty issues)\n    let result = export_jsonl_dirty(\n        &jsonl_path,\n        || Ok(dirty_issues.clone()),\n        || storage.clear_dirty(),\n    )?;\n\n    // Update export_hashes for dirty issues only\n    update_export_hashes_for_issues(&storage, &dirty_issues)?;\n\n    Ok(result.count)\n}\n\n/// Import beads from JSONL into SQLite.\n///\n/// Compares each bead in JSONL with SQLite state using content_hash.\n/// INSERTs new beads, UPDATEs changed beads, SKIPs unchanged beads.\n///\n/// Collision resolution: when both JSONL and SQLite have changes for the\n/// same bead, the one with the later `updated_at` timestamp wins.\n///\n/// NOTE: If there are unflushed beads (db-only or db-newer), this function\n/// will emit a warning but proceed. The collision resolution logic preserves\n/// SQLite versions when they are newer, so unflushed beads are protected.\n/// Run `bf sync --flush-only` first to silence the warning.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `workspace_dir` - Path to the workspace root (contains .beads/)\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(SyncResult)` - Import statistics\npub fn import(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<SyncResult> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir).ok_or_else(|| {\n        anyhow::anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display())\n    })?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let jsonl_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.jsonl_export);\n\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    // Check for unflushed beads and warn\n    let dirty_issues = storage.list_dirty_issues()?;\n    if !dirty_issues.is_empty() {\n        eprintln!(\n            \"WARNING: {} unflushed bead(s) exist in SQLite (modified/created since last flush to JSONL).\",\n            dirty_issues.len()\n        );\n        eprintln!(\"  Import will preserve SQLite versions when they are newer.\");\n        eprintln!(\"  Run 'bf sync --flush-only' first to flush these beads to JSONL.\");\n        let dirty_ids: Vec<String> = dirty_issues.iter().map(|i| i.id.clone()).collect();\n        if dirty_ids.len() <= 5 {\n            eprintln!(\"  Unflushed: {}\", dirty_ids.join(\", \"));\n        } else {\n            eprintln!(\n                \"  Unflushed: {}, ... and {} more\",\n                dirty_ids[..5].join(\", \"),\n                dirty_ids.len() - 5\n            );\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Stream import with content_hash comparison\n    let result = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n        import_jsonl(&jsonl_path, |issue| {\n            let incoming_hash = issue.content_hash();\n            let existing = Storage::get_issue_tx(tx, &issue.id)?;\n\n            match existing {\n                None => {\n                    // New bead - insert\n                    Storage::create_issue_tx(tx, &issue)?;\n                    Ok(UpsertResult::New)\n                }\n                Some(existing_issue) => {\n                    let existing_hash = existing_issue.content_hash();\n\n                    if incoming_hash == existing_hash {\n                        // Content unchanged - skip\n                        Ok(UpsertResult::Unchanged)\n                    } else {\n                        // Content changed - use deterministic collision resolution\n                        // The bead with the later updated_at wins\n                        if issue.updated_at > existing_issue.updated_at {\n                            Storage::update_issue_from_json_tx(tx, &issue)?;\n                            Ok(UpsertResult::Updated)\n                        } else {\n                            // SQLite version is newer - skip JSONL version\n                            Ok(UpsertResult::Unchanged)\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        })\n    })?;\n\n    // Rebuild blocked cache after import\n    storage.rebuild_blocked_cache()?;\n\n    // Clear dirty marks - after import from JSONL, db and JSONL are in sync\n    // Beads that were created/updated during import are now flushed to JSONL\n    storage.clear_dirty()?;\n\n    Ok(SyncResult {\n        imported: result.imported,\n        exported: 0,\n        updated: result.updated,\n        skipped: result.skipped,\n    })\n}\n\n/// Full sync: import then flush.\n///\n/// Performs both import and flush operations. Use this when you want to\n/// ensure bidirectional synchronization.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `workspace_dir` - Path to the workspace root (contains .beads/)\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(SyncResult)` - Sync statistics\npub fn sync(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<SyncResult> {\n    let import_result = import(workspace_dir)?;\n    let exported = flush(workspace_dir)?;\n\n    Ok(SyncResult {\n        imported: import_result.imported,\n        exported,\n        updated: import_result.updated,\n        skipped: import_result.skipped,\n    })\n}\n\n/// Update export_hashes table for a set of issues.\n///\n/// This tracks which beads have been exported and their content hashes,\n/// enabling incremental export operations.\nfn update_export_hashes_for_issues(storage: &Storage, issues: &[Issue]) -> Result<()> {\n    storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n        let now = Utc::now().to_rfc3339();\n\n        for issue in issues {\n            let hash = issue.content_hash();\n            tx.execute(\n                \"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO export_hashes (issue_id, content_hash, exported_at)\n                 VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3)\",\n                rusqlite::params![&issue.id, &hash, &now],\n            )?;\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    })\n}\n\n/// Find the .beads directory for a workspace.\npub fn find_workspace(start_dir: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf> {\n    find_beads_dir(start_dir)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", start_dir.display()))\n}\n\n/// Get the JSONL path for a workspace.\npub fn get_jsonl_path(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf> {\n    let beads_dir = find_workspace(workspace_dir)?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    Ok(beads_dir.join(metadata.jsonl_export))\n}\n\n/// Get the database path for a workspace.\npub fn get_db_path(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf> {\n    let beads_dir = find_workspace(workspace_dir)?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    Ok(beads_dir.join(metadata.database))\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n461\t\n462\t    let reclaimed = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n463\t        let stale_cutoff = chrono::Utc::now() - ?\n468\t             WHERE status = 'in_progress' AND updated_at < ?\",\n469\t            rusqlite::params![chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339(), stale_cutoff.to_rfc3339()],\n470\t        )?;\n471\t\n472\t        Ok::<_, anyhow::Error>(reclaimed)\n473\t    })?;\n474\t\n475\t    Ok(reclaimed)\n476\t}\n477\t\n478\t/// Initialize a new database from an existing JSONL file.\n479\t///\n480\t/// Use this to create a fresh database from a JSONL export without\n481\t/// affecting the existing database.\n482\t///\n483\t/// # Arguments\n484\t/// * `workspace_dir` - Path to the workspace root (contains .beads/)\n485\t/// * `jsonl_path` - Path to the JSONL file to import from\n486\t///\n487\t/// # Returns\n488\t/// * `Ok(usize)` - Number of beads imported\n489\tpub fn init_from_jsonl(workspace_dir: workspace_dir.display()))?;\n492\t    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n493\t    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n494\t\n495\t    // Check if JSONL exists\n496\t    if !jsonl_path.exists() {\n497\t        return Err(anyhow!(\"JSONL file not found at {}\", jsonl_path.display()));\n498\t    }\n499\t\n500\t    // Create new database and import JSONL\n501\t    let Storage::create_issue_tx(tx, &issue)?;\n506\t            Ok(UpsertResult::New)\n507\t        })\n508\t    })?;\n509\t\n510\t    // Rebuild blocked cache\n511\t    storage.rebuild_blocked_cache()?;\n512\t\n513\t    // Clear dirty marks - after import from JSONL, db and JSONL are in sync\n514\t    // (create_issue_tx doesn't mark dirty, but we clear for safety)\n515\t    storage.clear_dirty()?;\n516\t\n517\t    Ok(result.imported)\n518\t}\n519\t\n520\t/// Verify database schema version.\n521\t///\n522\t/// Checks that all required tables and indexes Arguments\n893\t    /// * `root_id` - The root issue ID\n894\t    /// * `direction` - \"down\" for what this depends on, \"up\" for what depends on this\n895\t    /// * `max_depth` - Maximum depth to traverse (0 = unlimited)\n896\t    ///\n897\t    /// # Returns\n898\t    /// Vector of tree nodes ordered by depth, suitable for tree display.\n899\t    pub fn get_dep_tree(\n900\t        &self,\n901\t        root_id: &str,\n902\t        direction: &str,\n903\t        max_depth: usize,\n904\t    ) -> Result<Vec<DepTreeNode>> {\n905\t        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n906\t\n907\t        // Build recursive CTE based on direction\n908\t        let (anchor_join, recursive_join, id_col, dep_col) = match direction {\n909\t            \"up\" => {\n910\t                // \"up\" means: find issues that depend on this one\n911\t                // Anchor: issues that directly depend on root\n912\t                // Recursive: issues that depend on those\n913\t                (\n914\t                    \"d.depends_on_id = ?1\",\n915\t                    \"d.depends_on_id = rec.id\",\n916\t                    \"d.issue_id\",\n917\t                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n918\t                )\n919\t            }\n920\t            _ => {\n921\t                // \"down\" (default): what this issue depends on\n922\t                // Anchor: issues that root directly depends on\n923\t                // Recursive: issues that those depend on\n924\t                (\n925\t                    \"d.issue_id = ?1\",\n926\t                    \"d.issue_id = rec.id\",\n927\t                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n928\t                    \"d.issue_id\",\n929\t                )\n930\t            }\n931\t        };\n932\t\n933\t        let depth_limit = if max_depth == 0 {\n934\t            String::new()\n935\t        } else {\n936\t            format!(\"AND rec.depth < {}\", max_depth)\n937\t        };\n938\t\n939\t        let sql = format!(\n940\t            \"WITH RECURSIVE dep_tree AS (\n941\t                -- Anchor: direct dependencies/dependents of root\n942\t                SELECT\n943\t                    {id_col} dep_type,\n949\t                    '{root_id}' || ',' || {id_col} as path\n950\t                FROM dependencies d\n951\t                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n952\t                WHERE {anchor_join}\n953\t\n954\t                UNION ALL\n955\t\n956\t                -- Recursive: dependencies of dependencies\n957\t                SELECT\n958\t                    {id_col} as id,\n959\t                    i.title,\n960\t                    i.status,\n961\t                    i.priority,\n962\t                    rec.depth + 1 as depth,\n963\t                    d.type as dep_type,\n964\t                    rec.path || ',' || {id_col} as path\n965\t                FROM dependencies d\n966\t                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n967\t                INNER JOIN dep_tree rec ON {recursive_join}\n968\t                WHERE rec.path NOT LIKE '%' || {id_col} || '%'\n969\t                {depth_limit}\n970\t            )\n971\t            SELECT id, title, status, priority, depth, dep_type, path\n972\t            FROM dep_tree\n973\t            ORDER BY depth, id\"\n974\t        );\n975\t\n976\t        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n977\t        let mut rows = stmt.query(params![root_id])?;\n978\t        let mut nodes = Vec::new();\n979\t        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n980\t            let path: String = row.get(6)?;\n981\t            // Detect cycles: if the ID appears more than once in path, it's a cycle\n982\t            let id: String = row.get(0)?;\n983\t            let is_cycle = path.matches(&id).count() > 1;\n984\t\n985\t            nodes.push(DepTreeNode {\n986\t                id: row.get(0)?,\n987\t                title: row.get(1)?,\n988\t                status: row.get(2)?,\n989\t                priority: row.get(3)?,\n990\t                depth: row.get(4)?,\n991\t                dep_type: row.get::<_, Option<String>>(5)?,\n992\t                path: if is_cycle {\n993\t                    format!(\"{} [CYCLE]\", path)\n994\t                } else {\n995\t                    path\n996\t                },\n997\t            });\n998\t        }\n999\t        Ok(nodes)\n1000\t    }\n1001\t\n1002\t    pub fn get_dependents(&self, depends_on_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<Dependency>> {\n1003\t        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n1004\t        let mut stmt =     Ok(result)\n1342\t    }\n1343\t\n1344\t    /// Get the score of the top candidate bead for claiming.\n1345\t    ///\n1346\t    /// Returns None if no candidates are available.\n1347\t    /// Used by claim_any() for cross-workspace scoring comparison.\n1348\t    ///\n1349\t    /// Note: critical_float is the raw float value (lower = more critical).\n1350\t    /// The claim scoring uses 1000.0 / (float + 1) as a bonus, which is\n1351\t    /// monotonically decreasing with float. Therefore, ordering by float ASC\n1352\t    /// is equivalent to ordering by bonus DESC.\n1353\t    ///\n1354\t    /// When model and harness are provided, uses velocity-aware scoring:\n1355\t    /// - LEFT JOINs velocity_stats on (issue_type, model, harness)\n1356\t    /// - Returns expected_seconds and combined_score for velocity-adjusted comparison\n1357\t    pub fn top_candidate_score(\n1358\t        &self,\n1359\t        model: Option<&str>,\n1360\t        harness: Option<&str>,\n1361\t    ) -> Result<Option<crate::claim::Score>> {\n1362\t        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n1363\t\n1364\t        if let (Some(m), Some(h)) = (model, harness) {\n1365\t            // Velocity-aware scoring: join velocity_stats and compute combined_score\n1366\t            let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n1367\t                \"SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n1368\t                        COALESCE(c.float, 999) as expected_seconds,\n1372\t                        (COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) * 3.0\n1373\t                         + (4 - i.priority) * 2.0\n1374\t                         + 1000.0 / (COALESCE(c.float, 999) + 1)) as combined_score\n1375\t                 FROM issues i\n1376\t                 LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n1377\t                 LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n1378\t                 LEFT JOIN velocity_stats vs ON vs.issue_type = i.issue_type\n1379\t                     AND vs.model = ?1\n1380\t                     AND vs.harness = ?2\n1381\t                 WHERE i.status = 'open'\n1382\t                   AND i.ephemeral = 0\n1383\t                   AND i.pinned = 0\n1384\t                   AND i.is_template = 0\n1385\t                   AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n1386\t                   AND NOT EXISTS (\n1387\t                       SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n1388\t                       INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n1389\t                       WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n1390\t                       AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n1391\t                       AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n1392\t                   )\n1393\t                 GROUP BY i.id\n1394\t                 ORDER BY\n1395\t                     combined_score / COALESCE(vs.p50_seconds, 1800) DESC,\n1396\t                     downstream_impact DESC,\n1397\t                     critical_float ASC,\n1398\t                     i.priority ASC,\n1399\t                     i.created_at ASC\n1400\t                 LIMIT 1\",\n1401\t            )?;\n1402\t\n1403\t            let mut rows = stmt.query(params![m, h])?;\n1404\t            if let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n1405\t                Ok(Some(crate::claim::Score::new(\n1406\t                    row.get(0)?,\n1407\t                    row.get(1)?,\n1408\t                    row.get(2)?,\n1409\t                    row.get(3)?,\n1410\t                    row.get(4)?,\n1411\t                    row.get(5)?,\n1412\t                )))\n1413\t            } else {\n1414\t                Ok(None)\n1415\t            }\n1416\t        } else {\n1417\t            // Standard scoring without velocity data\n1418\t            let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n1419\t                \"SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n1420\t                        COALESCE(c.float, 999) as critical_float,\n1421\t                        i.priority,\n1422\t                        CAST(strftime('%s', i.created_at) AS INTEGER) as created_ts\n1423\t                 FROM issues i\n1424\t                 LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n1425\t                 LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n1426\t                 WHERE i.status = 'open'\n1427\t                   AND i.ephemeral = 0\n1428\t                   AND i.pinned = 0\n1429\t                   AND i.is_template = 0\n1430\t                   AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n1431\t                   AND NOT EXISTS (\n1432\t params.push(Box::new(status.to_string()));\n                // Clear closed fields when transitioning from closed/tombstone to open\n                if !matches!(status, Status::Closed | Status::Tombstone) {\n                    updates.push(\"closed_at = NULL\");\n                    updates.push(\"close_reason = NULL\");\n                    updates.push(\"closed_by_session = NULL\");\n                }\n            }\n            if let Some(priority) = changes.priority {\n                updates.push(\"priority = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(priority));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref issue_type) = changes.issue_type {\n                updates.push(\"issue_type = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(issue_type.to_string()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref assignee) = changes.assignee {\n                updates.push(\"assignee = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(assignee.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref owner) = changes.owner {\n                updates.push(\"owner = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(owner.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(estimated_minutes) = changes.estimated_minutes {\n                updates.push(\"estimated_minutes = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(estimated_minutes));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref due_at) = changes.due_at {\n                updates.push(\"due_at = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(due_at.to_rfc3339()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref defer_until) = changes.defer_until {\n                updates.push(\"defer_until = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(defer_until.to_rfc3339()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref external_ref) = changes.external_ref {\n                updates.push(\"external_ref = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(external_ref.clone()));\n            }\n            let now = Utc::now();\n            if !updates.is_empty() {\n                updates.push(\"updated_at = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(now.to_rfc3339()));\n                let query = format!(\"UPDATE issues SET {} WHERE id = ?\", updates.join(\", \"));\n                let mut all_params: Vec<Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>> = params.into_iter().collect();\n                all_params.push(Box::new(id.to_string()));\n                let param_refs: Vec<&dyn rusqlite::ToSql> =\n                    all_params.iter().map(|p| p.as_ref()).collect();\n                tx.execute(&query, param_refs.as_slice())?;\n            }\n            // Handle label updates separately\n            if let Some(ref labels) = changes.labels {\n                tx.execute(\"DELETE FROM labels WHERE issue_id = ?1\", params![id])?;\n                for label in labels {\n                    tx.execute(\n                        \"INSERT INTO labels (issue_id, label) VALUES (?1, ?2)\",\n                        params![id, label],\n                    )?;\n                }\n            }\n            // Handle annotation updates separately\n            if let Some(ref annotations) = changes.annotations {\n                tx.execute(\n                    \"DELETE FROM bead_annotations WHERE bead_id = ?1\",\n                    params![id],\n                )?;\n                for (key, value) in annotations {\n                    tx.execute(\n                        \"INSERT INTO bead_annotations (bead_id, key, value) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3)\",\n                        params![id, key, value],\n                    )?;\n                }\n            }\n            // Mark as dirty for export (if any changes were made)\n            if !updates.is_empty() || changes.labels.is_some() || changes.annotations.is_some() {\n                tx.execute(\n                    \"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO dirty_issues (issue_id, marked_at) VALUES (?1, ?2)\",\n                    params![id, now.to_rfc3339()],\n                )?;\n            }\n            // Invalidate critical path cache if status changed (affects dependency graph)\n            if changes.status.is_some() {\n                invalidate_cache(tx)?;\n                compute_all_critical_paths(tx)?;\n            }\n            Ok(())\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Update an issue from JSONL import data.\n    ///\n    /// This replaces all fields of the existing issue with the imported data,\n    /// used during JSONL import when the content_hash differs.\n    pub fn update_issue_from_json(&self, issue: &Issue) -> Result<()> {\n                    &issue.content_hash, &issue.title,\n                    issue.description.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\"),\n                    issue.design.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\"),\n                    issue.acceptance_criteria.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\"),\n                    issue.notes.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\"),\n                    &issue.status.to_string(),\n                    &issue.priority, &issue.issue_type.to_string(), &issue.assignee, &issue.owner,\n                    &issue.estimated_minutes, &issue.created_at.to_rfc3339(), &issue.created_by,\n d.to_rfc3339()), &issue.deleted_by,\n                    &issue.delete_reason, &issue.original_type, &issue.compaction_level,\n                    issue.compacted_at.map(|d| d.to_rfc3339()),                    if issue.is_template { 1 } else { 0 },\n                    &issue.id,\n                ],\n            )?;\n\n            // Re-insert labels, dependencies, and comments\n            for label in &issue.labels {\n                tx.execute(\"INSERT INTO labels (issue_id, label) VALUES (?1, ?2)\", params![&issue.id, label])?;\n            }\n            for dep in )?;\n            }\n            for comment in &issue.comments {\n                tx.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO comments (id, issue_id, author, text, created_at) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5)\",\n                    params![\n                        &comment.id, &comment.issue_id, &comment.author, &comment.body,\n                        &comment.created_at.to_rfc3339(),\n                    ],\n                )?;\n            }\n\n            // Invalidate critical path cache after updating from JSON (may change deps/status)\n            invalidate_cache(tx)?;\n            compute_all_critical_paths(tx)?;\n\n            Ok(())\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn close_issue(&self, id: &str, reason: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        self.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            let now = Utc::now();\n            tx.execute(\n                \"UPDATE issues SET status = 'closed', closed_at = ?, close_reason = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                params![now.to_rfc3339(), reason, now.to_rfc3339(), id],\n            )?;\n            tx.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO events (issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, created_at) VALUES (?1, 'closed', ?2, NULL, ?3, ?4)\",\n                params![id, actor, reason, now.to_rfc3339()],\n            )?;\n            tx.execute(\n                \"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO dirty_issues (issue_id, marked_at) VALUES (?1, ?2)\",\n                params![id, now.to_rfc3339()],\n            )?;\n            // Update worker session with close time and duration for velocity tracking\n            crate::velocity::update_session_on_close(tx, id, now)?;\n            // Invalidate critical path cache: closing a bead can unblock dependents\n            invalidate_cache(tx)?;\n            compute_all_critical_paths(tx)?;\n            Ok(())\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn mark_dirty(&self, id: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        let conn =    match existing {\n                    None => {\n                        Self::create_issue_tx(tx, issue)?;\n                        Ok(UpsertResult::New)\n                    }\n                    Some(existing_issue) => {\n                        // Compute hash from incoming issue (content_hash is None from JSONL due to #[serde(skip)])\n                        let incoming_hash =                Ok(UpsertResult::Updated)\n                        } else {\n                            Ok(UpsertResult::Unchanged)\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            })\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn sync_to_jsonl(&self, jsonl_path: &Path, dirty_only: bool) -> Result<usize> {\n        if dirty_only {\n            let result = export_jsonl_dirty(\n                Some(ref val) if val.is_empty() => Ok(None),\n                Some(val) => Ok(Some(parse_datetime(val)?)),\n            }\n        };\n        let id: String = row.get(0)?;\n        Ok(Issue {\n            content_hash: row.get(1)?,\n            title: row.get(2)?,\n            description: row.get(3)?,\n            design: row.get(4)?,\n            acceptance_criteria: row.get(5)?,\n            notes: row.get(6)?,\n            status: Status::from_str(&status_str).unwrap_or(Status::Custom(status_str)),\n            priority: row.get(8)?,\n            issue_type: created_at: parse_datetime(row.get(13)?)?,\n            created_by: row.get(14)?,\n            updated_at: parse_datetime(row.get(15)?)?,\n            closed_at: parse_opt_dt(16)?,\n            close_reason: row.get(17)?,\n            closed_by_session: row.get(18)?,\n            due_at: parse_opt_dt(19)?,\n            defer_until: parse_opt_dt(20)?,\n            external_ref: row.get(21)?,\n            source_system: row.get(22)?,\n            source_repo: row.get(23)?,\n            deleted_at: parse_opt_dt(24)?,\n            deleted_by: row.get(25)?,\n            delete_reason: row.get(26)?,\n            original_type: row.get(27)?,\n            compaction_level: row.get(28)?,\n            compacted_at: parse_opt_dt(29)?,\n            compacted_at_commit:       is_template: row.get::<_, i32>(35)? != 0,\n            labels: Self::load_labels_conn(conn, &id)?,\n            dependencies: Self::load_dependencies_conn(conn, &id)?,\n            comments:   Ok(())\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_dependencies(&self, issue_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<Dependency>> {\n        self.load_dependencies(issue_id)\n    }\n\n    /// Get dependency tree rooted at an issue using recursive CTE.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    /// * `root_id` - The root issue ID\n    /// * `direction` - \"down\" for what this depends on, \"up\" for what depends on this\n    /// * `max_depth` - Maximum depth to traverse (0 = unlimited)\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    /// Vector of tree nodes ordered by depth, suitable for tree display.\n    pub fn get_dep_tree(\n        &self,\n        root_id: &str,\n        direction: &str,\n        max_depth: usize,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<DepTreeNode>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n\n        // Build recursive CTE based on direction\n        let (anchor_join, recursive_join, id_col, dep_col) = match direction {\n            \"up\" => {\n                // \"up\" means: find issues that depend on this one\n                // Anchor: issues that directly depend on root\n                // Recursive: issues that depend on those\n                (\n                    \"d.depends_on_id = ?1\",\n                    \"d.depends_on_id = rec.id\",\n                    \"d.issue_id\",\n                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n                )\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // \"down\" (default): what this issue depends on\n                // Anchor: issues that root directly depends on\n                // Recursive: issues that those depend on\n                (\n                    \"d.issue_id = ?1\",\n                    \"d.issue_id = rec.id\",\n                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n                    \"d.issue_id\",\n                )\n            }\n        };\n\n        let depth_limit = if max_depth == 0 {\n            String::new()\n        } else {\n            format!(\"AND rec.depth < {}\", max_depth)\n        };\n\n        let sql = format!(\n            \"WITH RECURSIVE dep_tree AS (\n                -- Anchor: direct dependencies/dependents of root\n                SELECT\n                    {id_col} as id,\n                    i.title,\n                    i.status,\n                    i.priority,\n                    0 as depth,\n                    d.type as dep_type,\n                    '{root_id}' || ',' || {id_col} as path\n                FROM dependencies d\n                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n                WHERE {anchor_join}\n\n                UNION ALL\n\n                -- Recursive: dependencies of dependencies\n                SELECT\n                    {id_col} as id,\n                    i.title,\n                    i.status,\n                    i.priority,\n                    rec.depth + 1 as depth,\n                    d.type as dep_type,\n                    rec.path || ',' || {id_col} as path\n                FROM dependencies d\n                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n                INNER JOIN dep_tree rec ON {recursive_join}\n                WHERE rec.path NOT LIKE '%' || {id_col} || '%'\n                {depth_limit}\n            )\n            SELECT id, title, status, priority, depth, dep_type, path\n            FROM dep_tree\n            ORDER BY depth, id\"\n        );\n\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(params![root_id])?;\n        let mut nodes = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            let path: String = row.get(6)?;\n            // Detect cycles: if the ID appears more than once in path, it's a cycle\n            let id: String = row.get(0)?;\n            let is_cycle = path.matches(&id).count() > 1;\n\n            nodes.push(DepTreeNode {\n                id: row.get(0)?,\n                title: row.get(1)?,\n                status: row.get(2)?,\n                priority: row.get(3)?,\n                depth: row.get(4)?,\n                dep_type: row.get::<_, Option<String>>(5)?,\n                path: if is_cycle {\n                    format!(\"{} [CYCLE]\", path)\n                } else {\n                    path\n                },\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(nodes)\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_dependents(&self, depends_on_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<Dependency>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n            \"SELECT issue_id, depends_on_id, type, metadata, thread_id, created_at, created_by FROM dependencies WHERE depends_on_id = ?1\",\n        )?;\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(params![depends_on_id])?;\n        let mut deps = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            let type_str: String = row.get(2)?;\n            deps.push(Dependency {\n                issue_id: row.get(0)?,\n                depends_on_id: row.get(1)?,\n                dep_type: DependencyType::from_str(&type_str)\n                    .unwrap_or(DependencyType::Custom(type_str)),\n                metadata: row\n                    .get::<_, Option<String>>(3)?\n                    .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str(&s).ok()),\n                thread_id: row.get(4)?,\n                created_at: parse_datetime(row.get(5)?)?,\n                created_by: row.get(6)?,\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(deps)\n    }\n\n    pub      params![issue_id],\n        )?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    pub fn search_issues(\n        &self,\n        query: Option<&str>,\n        status: &[Status],\n        issue_type: &[IssueType],\n        assignee: Option<&str>,\n        labels: &[String],\n        priority_min: Option<i32>,\n        priority_max: Option<i32>,\n        limit: usize,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<Issue>> {\n        let mut sql = String::from(\n            \"SELECT DISTINCT i.id, i.content_hash, i.title, i.description, i.design, i.acceptance_criteria, i.notes,\n                    i.status, i.priority, i.issue_type, i.assignee, i.owner, i.estimated_minutes,\n                    i.created_at, i.created_by, i.updated_at, i.closed_at, i.close_reason,\n                    i.closed_by_session, i.due_at, i.defer_until, i.external_ref, i.source_system,\n                    i.source_repo, i.deleted_at, i.deleted_by, i.delete_reason, i.original_type,\n                    i.compaction_level, i.compacted_at, i.compacted_at_commit, i.original_size,\n                    i.sender, i.ephemeral, i.pinned, i.is_template\n             FROM issues i\n             LEFT JOIN labels l ON i.id = l.issue_id\n             WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL\",\n        );\n        let mut params = Vec::new();\n        let mut param_idx = 1;\n        if let Some(q) = query {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\n                \" AND (i.title LIKE ?{} OR i.description LIKE ?{})\",\n                param_idx,\n                param_idx + 1\n            ));\n            params.push(format!(\"%{}%\", q));\n            params.push(format!(\"%{}%\", q));\n            param_idx += 2;\n        }\n        for s in status {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.status = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(s.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        for t in issue_type {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.issue_type = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(t.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(a) = assignee {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.assignee = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(a.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if !labels.is_empty() {\n            let label_conditions: Vec<String> = labels\n                .iter()\n                .enumerate()\n                .map(|(i, _)| format!(\"l.label = ?{}\", param_idx + i))\n                .collect();\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND ({}) \", label_conditions.join(\" OR \")));\n            for label in labels {\n                params.push(label.clone());\n                param_idx += 1;\n            }\n        }\n        if let Some(min) = priority_min {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.priority >= ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(min.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(max) = priority_max {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.priority <= ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(max.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        sql.push_str(\" ORDER BY i.priority ASC, i.created_at ASC\");\n        if limit > 0 {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" LIMIT {}\", limit));\n        }\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n        let param_refs: Vec<&dyn rusqlite::ToSql> =\n            params.iter().map(|p| p as &dyn rusqlite::ToSql).collect();\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(param_refs.as_slice())?;\n        let mut issues = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            issues.push(Self::row_to_issue_conn(&conn, row)?);\n        }\n        Ok(issues)\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_stats(&self) -> Result<Stats> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let total: i64 = conn.query_row(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issues WHERE deleted_at IS NULL\",\n            [],\n            |row| row.get(0),\n        )?;\n        let open: i64 = conn.query_row(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issues WHERE status = 'open' AND deleted_at IS NULL\",\n            [],\n            |row| row.get(0),\n        )?;\n        let in_progress: i64 = conn.query_row(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issues WHERE status = = 'closed' AND deleted_at IS NULL\",\n            [],\n            |row| row.get(0),\n        )?;\n        Ok(Stats {\n            total: total as usize,\n            open: open as usize,\n            in_progress: in_progress as usize,\n            closed: closed as usize,\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_stats_by_type(&self) -> Result<Vec<(String, i64)>> {\n        let conn =  }\n\n    pub fn get_stats_by_priority(&self) -> Result<Vec<(i32, i64)>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\"SELECT priority, COUNT(*) as count FROM }\n        Ok(result)\n    }\n\n    /// Get the score of the top candidate bead for claiming.\n    ///\n    /// Returns None if no candidates are available.\n    /// Used by claim_any() for cross-workspace scoring comparison.\n    ///\n    /// Note: critical_float is the raw float value (lower = more critical).\n    /// The claim scoring uses 1000.0 / (float + 1) as a bonus, which is\n    /// monotonically decreasing with float. Therefore, ordering by float ASC\n    /// is equivalent to ordering by bonus DESC.\n    ///\n    /// When model and harness are provided, uses velocity-aware scoring:\n    /// - LEFT JOINs velocity_stats on (issue_type, model, harness)\n    /// - Returns expected_seconds and combined_score for velocity-adjusted comparison\n    pub fn top_candidate_score(\n        &self,\n        model: Option<&str>,\n        harness: Option<&str>,\n    ) -> Result<Option<crate::claim::Score>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n\n        if let (Some(m), Some(h)) = (model, harness) {\n            // Velocity-aware scoring: join velocity_stats and compute combined_score\n            let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n                \"SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n                        COALESCE(c.float, 999) as critical_float,\n                        i.priority,\n                        CAST(strftime('%s', i.created_at) AS INTEGER) as created_ts,\n                        vs.p50_seconds as expected_seconds,\n                        (COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) * 3.0\n                         + (4 - i.priority) * 2.0\n                         + 1000.0 / (COALESCE(c.float, 999) + 1)) as combined_score\n                 FROM issues i\n                 LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                 LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n                 LEFT JOIN velocity_stats vs ON vs.issue_type = i.issue_type\n                     AND vs.model = ?1\n                     AND vs.harness = ?2\n                 WHERE i.status = 'open'\n                   AND i.ephemeral = 0\n                   AND i.pinned = 0\n                   AND i.is_template = 0\n                   AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n                   AND NOT EXISTS (\n                       SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n                       INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n                       WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n                       AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                       AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n                   )\n                 GROUP BY i.id\n                 ORDER BY\n                     combined_score / COALESCE(vs.p50_seconds, 1800) DESC,\n                     downstream_impact DESC,\n                     critical_float ASC,\n                     i.priority ASC,\n                     i.created_at ASC\n                 LIMIT 1\",\n            )?;\n\n            let mut rows = stmt.query(params![m, h])?;\n            if let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n                Ok(Some(crate::claim::Score::new(\n                    row.get(0)?,\n                    row.get(1)?,\n                    row.get(2)?,\n                    row.get(3)?,\n                    row.get(4)?,\n                    row.get(5)?,\n                )))\n            } else {\n                Ok(None)\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Standard scoring without velocity data\n            let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n                \"SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n                        COALESCE(c.float, 999) as critical_float,\n                        i.priority,\n                        CAST(strftime('%s', i.created_at) AS INTEGER) as created_ts\n                 FROM issues i\n                 LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                 LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n                 WHERE i.status = 'open'\n                   AND i.ephemeral = 0\n                   AND i.pinned = 0\n                   AND i.is_template = 0\n                   AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n                   AND NOT EXISTS (\n                       SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n                       INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n                       WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n                       AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                       AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n                   )\n                 GROUP BY i.id\n                 ORDER BY\n                     downstream_impact DESC,\n                     critical_float ASC,\n                     i.priority ASC,\n                     i.created_at ASC\n                 LIMIT 1\",\n            )?;\n\n            let mut rows = stmt.query([])?;\n            if let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n                let downstream_impact: i64 = row.get(0)?;\n                let critical_float: i64 = row.get(1)?;\n                let priority: i32 = row.get(2)?;\n                let created_at_ts: i64 = row.get(3)?;\n\n                // Compute combined_score for consistency\n                let combined_score = downstream_impact as f64 * 3.0\n                    + (4 - priority) as f64 * 2.0\n                    + 1000.0 / (critical_float as f64 + 1.0);\n\n                Ok(Some(crate::claim::Score::new(\n                    downstream_impact,\n                    critical_float,\n                    priority,\n                    created_at_ts,\n                    None, // No expected_seconds without velocity data\n                    combined_score,\n                )))\n            } else {\n                Ok(None)\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Record a worker session for tracking metadata.\n    ///\n    /// Stores worker metadata (model, harness, version) for each ));\n                }\n                // Proceed without unflushed check (db is unreadable)\n                // No --force needed since we can't detect unflushed beads anyway\n                eprintln!(\"WARNING: Database is corrupted and unreadable.\");\n                eprintln!(\"  Cannot detect unflushed beads - any db-only beads will be lost.\");\n                eprintln!(\"  Proceeding with repair from JSONL...\");\n                (Vec::new(), true)\n            }\n        }\n    } else {\n        // DB doesn't exist - no unflushed beads possible\n        (Vec::new(), false)\n    };\n\n    if !unflushed_ids.is_empty() {\n        if flush_first {\n            // Flush ALL beads to JSONL first (not just dirty ones)\n            // We must export everything because      ));\n        std::fs::copy(&db_path, &backup_path)?;\n        eprintln!(\"Backed up existing database to {}\", backup_path.display());\n    }\n\n    // Delete old database\n    if changes.\npub fn rebuild_cache(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n    storage.rebuild_blocked_cache()?;\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Reclaim stale in_progress beads.\n///\n/// Resets beads that have been in_progress for longer than the TTL\n/// back to open status.\n///\n///
